_about: Editable search + scoring config for fetch_candidates.py (Version B candidate finder). Derived from brief.md on 30 Oct 2026. 'query' is a boolean string sent to PubMed, Europe PMC and (if openalex=true) OpenAlex title+abstract search; 'pubmed'/'europepmc'/'openalex_query' override it per source. 'keywords' are lowercase regexes used to score EVERY record (incl. bulk bioRxiv/medRxiv/arXiv pulls). 'weight' reflects brief priority. Edit freely; no code changes needed.
psychedelic_terms: (psychedelic OR psychedelics OR psilocybin OR psilocin OR LSD OR "lysergic acid diethylamide" OR DMT OR dimethyltryptamine OR "5-MeO-DMT" OR mebufotenin OR ayahuasca OR mescaline OR MDMA OR ibogaine OR "serotonergic hallucinogen" OR hallucinogen OR psychoplastogen)
imaging_terms: (EEG OR electroencephalography OR MEG OR magnetoencephalography OR fMRI OR "functional MRI" OR "functional magnetic resonance" OR neuroimaging OR PET OR "positron emission" OR "brain imaging" OR "diffusion MRI" OR "event-related potential")

groups.name: psychedelic_imaging
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND {imaging_terms}

groups.name: psychedelic_any
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms}

groups.name: eeg_methods
groups.query: (EEG OR MEG OR electroencephalography OR magnetoencephalography) AND (aperiodic OR "1/f" OR "spectral exponent" OR specparam OR FOOOF OR microstate OR microstates OR "travelling wave" OR "traveling wave" OR "travelling waves" OR "traveling waves" OR "Lempel-Ziv" OR complexity OR entropy OR criticality OR "source imaging" OR "source localization" OR "waveform shape" OR "cross-frequency" OR "foundation model" OR "hidden Markov" OR bifurcation OR "state space" OR "neural dynamics")

groups.name: info_theory_dynamics
groups.query: ("integrated information" OR "information theory" OR "information-theoretic" OR "information decomposition" OR synergy OR "transfer entropy" OR "higher-order interactions" OR "brain dynamics" OR "dynamical systems" OR "connectome harmonics" OR eigenmodes OR "geometric eigenmodes") AND (brain OR neural OR cortex OR EEG OR fMRI OR MEG)

groups.name: comp_modelling
groups.query: ("whole-brain model" OR "whole-brain modelling" OR "whole-brain modeling" OR "neural mass" OR "neural field" OR "dynamic causal modelling" OR "dynamic causal modeling" OR "mean-field" OR "computational model") AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG) AND (psychedelic OR drug OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR ketamine OR propofol OR psychiatric OR addiction OR depression OR schizophrenia)

groups.name: addiction_imaging
groups.query: (addiction OR "substance use disorder" OR gambling OR "alcohol use disorder" OR nicotine OR smoking OR "cocaine use" OR "opioid use disorder" OR craving) AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG OR PET OR neuroimaging OR "event-related potential")

groups.name: psychedelic_addiction
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND (addiction OR "substance use" OR alcohol OR nicotine OR smoking OR gambling OR opioid OR cocaine OR methamphetamine)

groups.name: pharmaco_imaging_other
groups.query: (ketamine OR esketamine OR propofol OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR sevoflurane OR dexmedetomidine OR xenon OR "nitrous oxide" OR cannabis OR THC OR cannabidiol OR methylphenidate OR amphetamine OR modafinil OR zolpidem OR benzodiazepine) AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR electroencephalography)

groups.name: mental_health_imaging
groups.query: (depression OR "major depressive" OR schizophrenia OR psychosis OR bipolar OR anxiety OR PTSD OR OCD OR "mental health") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI) AND (dynamics OR complexity OR entropy OR aperiodic OR "information theory" OR "machine learning" OR "normative model" OR biomarker)
groups._why: scope 30 Oct: other disorders only if psychedelic or treatment-prediction imaging; those are scored by psychedelic_* and treatment_prediction

groups.name: brain_body
groups.query: ("heartbeat evoked" OR "heartbeat-evoked" OR respiration OR breathing OR respiratory OR gastric OR electrogastrography OR EGG OR "gastric rhythm" OR "cardiac cycle" OR "heart rate variability" OR interoception OR "brain-body" OR "brain-heart" OR "gut-brain" OR "body-brain") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR "BOLD" OR "neural oscillations" OR neuroimaging)
groups._why: secondary but Patrick is building an EEG/EGG/ECG/respiration pipeline; fMRI explicitly included (30 Oct)

groups.name: plasticity_nonhal
groups.query: (psychoplastogen OR "non-hallucinogenic" OR nonhallucinogenic OR tabernanthalog OR zalsupindole OR "beta-arrestin" OR "dendritic spine" OR neuroplasticity OR "synaptic plasticity" OR SV2A) AND (psychedelic OR ketamine OR antidepressant OR "5-HT2A" OR serotonin)
groups._scoring_note: keywords alone are generic, so this group also needs a psychedelic/ketamine/antidepressant word

groups.name: preclinical_psychedelic
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND (mice OR mouse OR rat OR rats OR rodent OR "in vitro" OR neurons OR zebrafish)

groups.name: metabolic_psych
groups.query: ("metabolic psychiatry" OR "ketogenic diet" OR ketone OR "GLP-1" OR semaglutide OR tirzepatide OR "brain energy metabolism" OR "insulin resistance" OR mitochondrial) AND (depression OR schizophrenia OR bipolar OR psychiatric OR "mental health" OR addiction OR "alcohol use")

groups.name: stimulation
groups.query: ("temporal interference" OR "transcranial magnetic stimulation" OR TMS-EEG OR "focused ultrasound") AND (addiction OR craving OR EEG OR nicotine OR smoking)

groups.name: own_centre
groups.pubmed: "Centre for Psychedelic Research"[ad] OR "Center for Psychedelic Research"[ad] OR ("Imperial College"[ad] AND (psychedelic* OR psilocybin OR DMT OR LSD))
groups.europepmc: AFF:"Centre for Psychedelic Research" OR (AFF:"Imperial College" AND (psychedelic OR psilocybin OR DMT OR LSD))

groups.name: wildcard_top_journals
groups.pubmed: ("Nature"[ta] OR "Science"[ta] OR "Cell"[ta] OR "Neuron"[ta] OR "Nat Neurosci"[ta] OR "Nat Hum Behav"[ta] OR "Nat Med"[ta] OR "N Engl J Med"[ta] OR "Lancet"[ta] OR "Lancet Psychiatry"[ta] OR "JAMA"[ta] OR "JAMA Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Nat Rev Neurosci"[ta] OR "Trends Cogn Sci"[ta] OR "Trends Neurosci"[ta] OR "Nat Mental Health"[ta] OR "Mol Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Am J Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Biol Psychiatry"[ta]) AND (brain OR neuron* OR neural OR cortex OR cortical OR neuroscience OR psychiatr* OR cognition)
groups.europepmc: (JOURNAL:"Nature" OR JOURNAL:"Science" OR JOURNAL:"Cell" OR JOURNAL:"Neuron" OR JOURNAL:"Nature neuroscience" OR JOURNAL:"Nature human behaviour") AND (brain OR neuron OR neural OR cortex OR cortical)
groups._why: retrieval only; the venue term (top_venue_bonus) does the scoring

groups._why: core interest 7 (30 Oct): neural generators / biophysics of EEG-MEG
groups.query: ("neural generators" OR "generators of the EEG" OR "laminar" OR "current source density" OR "forward model" OR "biophysical model" OR "dipole" OR "volume conduction" OR "physiological basis" OR "cellular origin" OR "origin of the EEG" OR "simultaneous intracranial and scalp" OR "scalp and intracranial" OR "pyramidal neurons") AND (EEG OR MEG OR electroencephalography OR magnetoencephalography OR "local field potential")

groups.name: travelling_waves
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: ("traveling wave" OR "travelling wave" OR "traveling waves" OR "travelling waves" OR "propagating wave" OR "cortical waves" OR "wave propagation") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ECoG OR cortex OR cortical OR "local field potential" OR fMRI)

groups.name: dcm_wholebrain
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: ("dynamic causal modelling" OR "dynamic causal modeling" OR "dynamic causal model" OR "canonical microcircuit" OR "whole-brain model" OR "whole-brain modelling" OR "whole-brain modeling" OR "neural mass model" OR "neural field model" OR "spectral DCM") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ERP OR "event-related" OR "resting state" OR "resting-state" OR fMRI)

groups.name: aperiodic_waveform
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: (aperiodic OR "1/f" OR "spectral exponent" OR "spectral slope" OR FOOOF OR specparam OR bycycle OR "non-sinusoidal" OR "nonsinusoidal" OR "waveform shape" OR "cycle-by-cycle" OR "oscillatory bursts") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ECoG OR "local field potential" OR oscillation*)

groups.name: mmn
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: ("mismatch negativity" OR MMN OR "roving oddball" OR "auditory oddball" OR "deviance detection" OR "predictive coding") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ERP OR "event-related")

groups.name: gambling
groups._why: gambling especially (addiction core); imaging or psychedelic required
groups.query: (gambling OR "gambling disorder" OR "pathological gambling" OR "problem gambling") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR PET OR neuroimaging OR "event-related potential" OR psilocybin OR psychedelic)

groups.name: cue_reactivity
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: ("cue reactivity" OR "cue-reactivity" OR "cue-induced" OR "drug cue" OR "smoking cue" OR "gambling cue" OR "attentional bias") AND (EEG OR "event-related potential" OR ERP OR LPP OR "late positive potential" OR fMRI OR MEG)

groups.name: spatial_autocorr
groups._why: one of Patrick's current analysis interests (generic topic)
groups.query: ("spatial autocorrelation" OR "spatial autocorrelation-preserving" OR "spin test" OR "spatial null model" OR "spatial null models" OR BrainSMASH OR "variogram" OR "spatial smoothness") AND (fMRI OR "brain maps" OR cortex OR cortical OR connectivity OR neuroimaging)

groups.name: altered_states_nondrug
groups._why: scope 30 Oct: non-drug altered states count like drugs
groups.query: (breathwork OR "holotropic" OR "connected breathing" OR hyperventilation OR meditation OR "jhana" OR hypnosis OR "altered state of consciousness" OR "altered states of consciousness" OR "flotation" OR "dreamachine" OR "stroboscopic") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR neuroimaging OR "brain dynamics" OR complexity)

groups.name: treatment_prediction
groups._why: scope 30 Oct: predicting treatment outcome from EEG/fMRI, esp. psychedelic or stimulation
groups.query: (predict* AND (response OR outcome OR remission OR responder*)) AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG OR neuroimaging) AND (psilocybin OR psychedelic OR ketamine OR esketamine OR TMS OR "transcranial magnetic" OR tDCS OR "deep brain stimulation" OR ECT OR "electroconvulsive" OR antidepressant OR treatment)

groups.name: sleep_consciousness
groups._why: scope 30 Oct: only ground-breaking sleep/consciousness work; low base weight, relies on venue/named/biorxiv-top to rise
groups.query: (sleep OR "slow waves" OR "sleep spindles" OR consciousness OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR "disorders of consciousness") AND (EEG OR MEG OR intracranial OR "high-density")

groups.name: reviews_core
groups.pubmed: (Review[pt] OR "Systematic Review"[pt] OR "Meta-Analysis"[pt]) AND ((psychedelic* OR psilocybin OR LSD OR DMT OR MDMA OR ketamine OR psychoplastogen*) OR ((EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR neuroimaging) AND (complexity OR dynamics OR "information theory" OR aperiodic OR oscillations OR addiction OR depression OR consciousness OR interoception)) OR ("brain dynamics" OR "integrated information" OR "whole-brain model*" OR "neural mass"))
groups.europepmc: (PUB_TYPE:"review" OR PUB_TYPE:"systematic-review" OR PUB_TYPE:"meta-analysis") AND ((psychedelic OR psilocybin OR LSD OR DMT OR MDMA OR ketamine OR psychoplastogen) OR ((EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR neuroimaging) AND (complexity OR dynamics OR "information theory" OR aperiodic OR oscillations OR addiction OR depression OR consciousness OR interoception)) OR ("brain dynamics" OR "integrated information" OR "whole-brain model" OR "neural mass"))

groups.name: reviews_top_journals
groups.pubmed: "Nat Rev Neurosci"[ta] OR "Trends Cogn Sci"[ta] OR "Trends Neurosci"[ta] OR "Annu Rev Neurosci"[ta] OR "Annu Rev Psychol"[ta] OR "Nat Rev Psychol"[ta] OR "Nat Rev Drug Discov"[ta] OR "Pharmacol Rev"[ta] OR ("Neuron"[ta] AND Review[pt]) OR ("Nat Neurosci"[ta] AND Review[pt]) OR ("Lancet Psychiatry"[ta] AND Review[pt]) OR ("Mol Psychiatry"[ta] AND Review[pt])

named_researchers._note: From brief.md (supervisor + named examples + 'wider field' list). PubMed [fau] queries; also matched against author lists of every record. 'strict' = surname too common, require full first name.

modality_bonus.fmri_re: fmri|functional mri|functional magnetic resonance|bold signal|resting[- ]state network|functional connectivity

tier2: proceedings of the national academy of sciences
biological psychiatry: cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging
venues._comment: top_venue_bonus: small, modest, separate configurable term (NOT impact-factor weighting; Patrick wants to discuss IF weighting first). Set both to 0 to disable.

bulk_sources._note: Bulk sources return EVERYTHING posted in the window; records below min_keyword_score (group keyword + modality score) are dropped before ranking.

scoring.engineering_re: emotion recognition|motor imagery|brain[- ]computer interface|\bbci\b|seizure (detection|prediction|forecast)|sleep stag(e|ing) (classification|scoring)|driver|fatigue detection|(deep|machine) learning (model|framework|network) for|classification accuracy|foundation model|transformer (network|model)|convolutional neural|wearable|artifact removal|self-powered|graphene|nanogenerator|triboelectric|hydrogel electrode|flexible electronics
scoring._engineering_comment: EEG engineering/ML-application papers (BCI, classifiers) are not what the brief means by novel analysis; penalised, not dropped
scoring.ml_comment: ML / EEG foundation models are a long-term goal, not current: penalised via engineering_re unless psychedelic

_group_rules: Group scoring: a group counts if one of its 'keywords' matches title/abstract (title = full weight, abstract-only = 0.6x), or if the record was returned by that group's API query (0.6x). 'require_imaging' = also needs an EEG/MEG/fMRI/PET-type word; 'all_of' = all listed groups must match ('@imaging' imaging word, '@addiction' addiction word, '@self' this group's own keywords); 'also_requires_re' = an extra regex that must match. reviews_only groups only feed the separate reviews list.

keyword_negations._comment: if a keyword's match is only explained by a non-psychedelic usage, ignore it

current_analyses._comment: Separate labelled term: extra boost when a paper matches one of Patrick's current/upcoming analyses (brief, 30 Oct). Title hit = full, abstract hit = 0.6x.
